description: A utility file for verifying the presence of specific icon assets in the Flutter app's AssetManifest.

methods.name: hasExpectedIconsInManifest
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the AssetManifest JSON and checks for the presence of specific icon assets ('assets/icons/got_x.png' and 'assets/icons/got_o.png'). Returns true if both are present, or if the manifest cannot be loaded (fallback).
